frozen_before: source observation values and WTI relationship inspection; metadata inspected only
author: Specialized division
oos_exposure: UNKNOWN for repo; this run will not load2024+ WTI or analysis source values
signal: 100*ln(activity_m/activity_m_minus_12); both positive, complete months only; no filling
primary_test: Pearson corr(I_m, P_(m+1)/P_m-1), monthly last Yahoo CL=F Close; no p-value/significance claim
lag_definition: corr(I_m,r_(m+k)); r_j=P_j/P_(j-1)-1; k>0 activity leads WTI
dollar_robustness: corr(I_m,P_(m+1)-P_m), retain nonpositive daily-price windows; report count
placebo: I_(m-12) against r_(m+1), no circular wrap, reset shift within each split
scenarios: exclude any signal/source denominator/target window overlapping calendar2020
one extra month assumed availability delay I_(m-1) against r_(m+1)
baseline: corr(current WTI monthly return r_m,r_(m+1)); conditional incremental effect NOT_RUN
price_rule: return month excluded if any daily Close from previous month last trading date through current month last trading date is missing/nonpositive; no clipping; endpoint beyond2023 unavailable
split_rule: signal observation month and target return start/end must remain in same train or validation split; targets crossing2020-12 or2023-12 purged
asof_status: NOT_PROVEN as-of-safe; latest revised snapshot, actual historical release timestamps absent; observed-month association only
minimum: at least24 valid monthly primary pairs per split for relationship discussion; below threshold stays descriptive/PARK
decision_rule: data quality/reproducibility determines research continuation; no universal correlation cutoff, no winning-index claim; stale-vintage blocker=>PARK even with data
family: per candidate:4 Pearson lags+1 dollar+1 shifted placebo+2 scenarios+1 WTI baseline per split; all reported, no inferential multiple-testing discovery
event_study: NOT_RUN: no source-defined exogenous event list preregistered
uncertainty: inference NOT_PROVEN; descriptive effect and paired n only
name: Mississippi Locks27 grain movements
aggregation: sum four commodities by week ending date at MS Locks27 (accept metadata legacy alias Miss Locks27), then mean weekly short tons among all Saturday week endings in calendar month; ignore provider month/year majority-day labels. Every expected Saturday and four commodity cells required; zero preserved.
